source_policy: Reuse immutable source-authored historical quotes and complete scalar/source multiplicities. A requires separately certified exact event and position gold. B must cover both entire named content cores and stay inside the union of the named permissible source extents. The core is a finite paragraph-level change witness, not an assertion that every scalar changed. No unselected intervening source, heading, page, or nearby context is allowed. No whitespace, ligature or source multiplicity is silently erased by evaluation. Missing or unresolved sources are failures, never empty successful matches.
